name: short-spreadsheets
title: Record a sale and a purchase in the Excel workbook, see your profit
description: A sole trader opens the free Basic Sole Trader Excel workbook, enters one sale and one purchase for April, and reads the profit from the Profit & Loss sheet, in under two minutes. The workbook is shown in Collabora Online, which runs the real .xlsx.

localApp.command: node scripts/collabora-sheet-host.js --package 'GB Accounts Basic Sole Trader 2027-04-05 (Apr27) Excel 2007' ${COLLABORA_URL:+--cool-url $COLLABORA_URL --wopi-base http://$(hostname -i | cut -d' ' -f1):8099}

steps.note: The host's start page posts the workbook to Collabora, so the page that loads is the editor itself. The first load in a fresh container can take a minute, which sheetPrepare waits out.

steps.caption: This is the free Basic Sole Trader workbook from our spreadsheets site.
steps.headline: The free workbook
steps.note: Points at the workbook's title, the merged cell B2:E2, so the headline sits clear of it; the band for a step with no target covers row 2.

steps.caption: Each month has a sheet for sales and one for purchases.
steps.headline: A sheet for every month
steps.instruction: Download the Basic Sole Trader workbook from the spreadsheets site and open it in Excel.
steps.note: Points at the Sales heading so the headline sits above it, over the instruction text: the band for a step with no target covers the workbook's title, and a card above the sheet tabs covers their labels.

steps.caption: Open April's sales.
steps.headline: April's sales
steps.instruction: Choose the sheet for April's sales.

steps.caption: Type the date the customer paid you, then the job.
steps.headline: Date and job
steps.instruction: Enter the date the customer paid you and the job in the first empty row.

steps.caption: How they paid. Leave it blank if they still owe you.
steps.headline: How they paid
steps.instruction: Enter Bank in the paid column, or leave it blank if the customer still owes you.

steps.caption: And the amount: £500.
steps.headline: Amount: £500
steps.instruction: Enter the amount of the sale and press Enter.

steps.caption: The month's total updates as you type.
steps.headline: April's sales: £500
steps.instruction: Read the month's total at the top of the sheet.

steps.caption: Now April's purchases: plants and compost for the job.
steps.headline: A purchase
steps.instruction: Choose the sheet for April's purchases.

steps.caption: The expense letter sorts it. S is for materials you use on jobs.
steps.headline: Letter S: materials
steps.instruction: Enter the date, what you bought, Bank, and the expense letter, such as s for materials.

steps.caption: They cost £200.
steps.headline: Amount: £200
steps.instruction: Enter the amount of the purchase and press Enter.

steps.caption: The Profit & Loss sheet adds it up for you.
steps.headline: The Profit & Loss sheet

steps.caption: £500 of sales, £200 of costs: £300 profit.
steps.headline: Net profit: £300
steps.instruction: Read the net profit for the year so far in the total column.
